description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeTerminationDaoTest' for testing the 'EmployeeTerminationDao' class within the OrangeHRM application. It includes setup methods and tests for saving and retrieving employee termination records and termination reasons.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for EmployeeTerminationDao, testing save and retrieval of employee termination data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeTerminationDao, and populates test data from a fixture.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Tests saving a new EmployeeTerminationRecord and verifies that the data was saved correctly.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Tests retrieving an employee termination record by ID and verifies its fields.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of termination reasons and checks their count and names.
